name: Barbell Seal Row
steps: Lie chest-down on an elevated flat bench so a barbell hangs freely beneath you with straight arms, and take a wider-than-shoulder overhand grip.
Brace your core and press your chest and hips steadily into the bench.
Drive your elbows smoothly behind you to pull the bar up until it touches or nears the underside of the bench.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension without letting it bang on the floor.
tips: Keep your chest pinned against the bench without kicking your legs or arching upward.
Squeeze your shoulder blades cleanly together at the top of each repetition.
